functions.name: sharing_user_ids
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sharing_user_ids(viewer uuid)
 RETURNS uuid[]
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE PARALLEL SAFE
AS $function$
    SELECT array_append(
      ARRAY(
        SELECT peer.user_id FROM sharing_members peer
        WHERE peer.user_id <> viewer
          AND peer.group_id = (
            SELECT own.group_id FROM sharing_members own WHERE own.user_id = viewer
          )
      ),
      viewer
    )
  $function$
